title: Game Design & Technical Bible
subtitle: Every screen, every number, every system - and everything that still needs fixing
engine: Vanilla JavaScript + Three.js, no build step
author: Legendterra
note: This book is the reference for the next development passes. Part V is a numbered issue register: every entry names the file, the evidence, and the fix, so a later pass can work from it without re-reading the codebase. The Status column was refreshed in v5.2.2, which closed BUG-018 (the backdrop is now themed, textured and lit from its own sky) and BUG-026 (a horizon line that stood on the level-wide median instead of on the ground the player is walking on), and added the two tools that measure them: `npm run qa:backdrop` (346 checks over ten floors) and `npm run shots:backdrop` (the contact sheet).
